differences.what: A grounds the cabinet with a soft contact shadow and a floor-to-wall falloff; B sits on a flat, uniform pale-blue field with no floor plane or shadow, so the speaker reads as cut out and floating
A's backdrop has a graded light (bright upper right, darker left) that models the set; B's background is a dead flat fill (luminance range about 5 levels)
A's clear cabinet and horn read as lit, luminous tinted acrylic with bright edges and internal glow; B's cabinet is dim, muddy navy with flat light, so the interior parts look grey and murky
B is compositionally cramped: the horn runs nearly to the left edge and the cabinet base almost touches the frame bottom; A leaves balanced margins

A has a painterly, denoise-smeared texture at 2-3x: soft, wobbly edges on the side handle and frame rails and watercolour blotching in the interior; B's edges and hardware are cleaner and geometrically crisp
B's horn shows clearer refraction and a defined rim, and its port flanges and screw heads are sharper; in A the horn rim and driver are softer and the port glass smears
